programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E05 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 5, Serbia
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E06 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 6, Canada (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E07 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E08 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E09 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E10 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E11 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E12 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 12, Curacao
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 13, Jordan
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E14 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 14, Greece
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E15 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E16 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E01 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 1, Norway - World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 2, Germany - FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E03 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 3, Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) & Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E04 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E05 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E06 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 6, Finland
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E07 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E08 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E09 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E10 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E11 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E12 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E13 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E14 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E15 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E16 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E01 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 1, World Strongest Viking
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E02 SCL S6 Ep2 FIBO Power
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E03 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 3, Turkey
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E04 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E05 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 6, Russia
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E07 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E08 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E09 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E10 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 10, Portugal
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Hard Boiled
programme.desc: Laittoman aselastin ratsia päättyy verilöylyyn, mikä pakottaa väkivaltaisen poliisin ja salaisen soluttautujan yhteistyöhön triadien imperiumin jahtaamisessa. John Woon ikonisimmassa ja räjähtävimmässä elokuvassa Hard Boiled nähdään kivenkovaa gangsteritoimintaa, jossa jokainen tulitaistelu on näyte tarkkuudesta ja hulluudesta. Luodit lentävät ja ruumiit kaatuvat, kun kukaan ei enää tiedä, keneen voi luottaa.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam on polkupyörälähetti New Yorkin vaarallisilla kaduilla. Hän selviää kaikesta kahdella pyörällä, mutta velka paikalliselle mafialle pakottaa hänet ottamaan jalat alleen. Hän tapaa sattumalta kauniin ja upean Nikkin, joka johdattaa Camin parkourin lumoavaan ja henkeäsalpaavaan maailmaan. Tämän akrobatiataitoja kehittävän ekstremelajin myötä Cam keksii mahdollisuuden päästä eroon kaikista ongelmistaan kertaheitolla.

programme.title: TMNT
programme.desc: Splinter; rotta sensei; aistii, että hänen neljä teini-ikäistä kilpikonnaopettajaansa ovat eronneet ja heidän on luotava side voittaakseen muinaisen hirviön.

programme.title: Vampire Academy
programme.desc: Lissa ja Rose ovat 17-vuotiaita tyttöjä, jotka käyvät lukiota monien muiden 17-vuotiaiden tapaan. He eroavat muista siten, että Lissa juo verta ja heidän lukionsa on salainen sisäoppilaitos rauhantahtoisille Moroi-vampyyreille ja heidän suojelijoilleen! Rose on yksi suojelijoista ja puolustaa Lissaa hinnalla millä hyvänsä. Epäonnistuneen pakoyrityksen jälkeen tytöt päätyvät kaikkein vaarallisimpaan paikkaan: vampyyriakatemiaan!

programme.title: Mutaa kuonoon! Sanoo virtahepo
programme.desc: "Hyväsydämiset Slim ja Tom törmäävät Afrikassa vaikutusvaltaiseen saksalaiseen Jack Ormondiin, joka viettää luksuselämää pyydystämällä villieläimiä ja lähettämällä ne eläintarhaan Kanadaan. Moinen vapaudenriisto, röyhkeys ja puolustuskyvyttömillä elämillä rahastaminen saa kaksikon näkemään punaista. Joidenkin on pidettävä eläinten puolia ja annettava Ormondille opetus, joka ei hevillä unohdu.Vaikka kyseinen kaksikko pitääkin eläinten puolia, ei se tee heistä vaarattomia pehmoja, päinvastoin. Asettuminen Ormondia vastaan antaa Slimille ja Tomille mahdollisuuden siihen, mistä he todella tykkäävät: antaa Ormondille ja tämän miehille oikein urakalla turpaan!"

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Hurmaava Jon on epäonnistunut elämässään ja päättää lähteä tavoittelemaan menetettyä rakkautta. Autoekspertti Luke pakenee menneisyyttään. Yhdessä hampurilaispaikassa työskentelevän vegaaniaktivisti Keiran kanssa he rikkovat normeja ja päätyvät ajamaan “lainatulla” keltaisella Mini Cooperilla Uuden-Seelannin poikki, poliisi ja media perässään.

programme.title: Senkka nenästä pojat!
programme.desc: Järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vedonlyöjät, korttihait ja huijarit piinaavat toimillaan Miamia, ja poliisin johto on päättänyt ottaa kovat keinot käyttöön ja puhdistaa kaupungin. Mutta koska poliisin omat resurssit eivät riitä toivottuun lopputulokseen, värvätään veljekset, Johnny ja Charlie Flippo, likaisen työn hommaan...Vaikka Johnny on laivaston upseeri ja Charlie vain rekkakuski, on heidän urbaanit selviytymiskykynsä ja kontaktit legendaariset. Veljekset sukeltavat alamaailman kuvioihin kuin kalat veteen, ja pistävät taidoillaan sekä nyrkeillään rikollisten päät sekaisin! Mutta Johnny ja Charlie eivät ole kuvioissa mukana hyvää hyvyyttään - täytyyhän omista eduista pitää myös kiinni.

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthyn tähdittämä räävittömän hillitön komedia Elokuva sijoittuu Los Angelesin laitamille, jossa nuket ja ihmiset elävät rinta rinnan. Kaksi erimielistä etsivää, toinen ihminen, toinen nukke, joutuvat työskentelemään yhdessä selvittääkseen kuka murhaa julmasti suositun The Happytime Gang -nukkeshow’n entisiä tähtiä.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: "Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman, jolle vanhemmat rouvat jalokivineen ovat helppoja saaliita. Pian kuitenkin panokset pelissä muuttuvat kovemmiksi, kun Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun. Mafian ollessa valmis raivaamaan todistajat hengiltä tylyn armottomalla tyylillään, on Parkerin suojeltava Tonya ja varmistettava tämän pääsy elossa todistamaan. Kytän ja varkaan epätavallinen taistelupari saa aikaa valtaisaa tuhoa alamaailman keskuudessa..."

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen. Hän saa yliluonnolliset supervoimat, ja pian Miamin rikoskäyrät ovat rajussa laskussa. Vastavetona päättävät kaupungin päärikolliset ratkaista ongelman nimeltä Dave Speed hinnalla ja keinolla millä hyvänsä... Superkytän voimat joutuvat kerta toisensa jälkeen todelliselle koetukselle, mutta ei hätää, niin kauan kuin hän ei näe mitään punaista. Kyseinen väri on Davelle kuin kryptoniitti Teräsmiehelle...

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: Vuoteen 1903 sijoittuva ihmisjahtidraama Jäljittäjä alkaa kun Arjan (Ray Winstone), Etelä-Afrikan buurisodista selviytynyt sissi, saapuu Uuden-Seelannin siirtokuntaan ja hänelle luvataan palkkio Kereaman (Temuera Morrison), sotilaan tappamisesta syytetyn maori merimiehen, kiinniottamisesta. Tehtävä, jonka pitäisi olla helppo mestarijäljittäjä Arjanille muuttuu mukaansatempaavaksi ja vaaralliseksi kissa ja hiiri -leikiksi Kereaman, joka vannoo koko ajan viattomuuttaan, paetessa ja jäädessä kiinni yhä uudestaan. Yliotteen vaihtuessa vuoronperään mieheltä toiselle, Arjan ja Kereama alkavat tutustumaan toisiinsa – ja lopulta kunnioittamaan toisiaan.

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: Loppuunpalaneen yksityisen turva-agentin on määrä kuljettaa arvokas kiinalainen antiikkiesine ulos Shanghaista, mutta matkan varrelle tulee vastoinkäymisiä.

programme.title: Crown Vic
programme.desc: Seuraa yhtä unohtumatonta yötä losangelesilaisen poliisin Ray Mandelin elämässä hänen jahdatessaan kahta karussa olevaa poliisintappajaa. Yön edetessä Mandel löytää itsensä käymästä epätoivoista taistelua aikaa vastaan yrittäessään löytää kadoksissa olevan tytön, kun hän ja hänen työparinsa Nick Holland väijyvät Los Angelesin vaarallisilla kaduilla poliisiautossaan, suojanaan vain hyvin ohuet metallilevyt ja lasi…

programme.title: Haven
programme.desc: Cayman-saaret…palmuja, hiekkaa, rantapupuja ja aurinkoleijonia kristallinkirkkaan meren äärellä. Mutta lentoliikenne tuo saarille perusturistin lisäksi toisenlaistakin väkeä. Kuten FBI:n etsimiä veropakolaisia, joiden omaisuus on teipattu keskikehon ympärille tuhteina setelinippuina. Auringon laskiessa saarilla käydään monenlaista bisnestä, joista osa ei kestä päivänvaloa. Saarilla riittää bileitä, seksiä ja jääkylmiä drinkkejä ja aina löytyy joku, joka erottelee amatöörit ammattilaisista kovalla kädellä.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Yritysvakoilun hämärässä valtakunnassa kyllästynyt jokamies kompastuu petoksen verkkoon ja hänestä tulee tietämätön vakooja. Kun hän navigoi petoksessa ja petoksessa, hän tekee yhteistyötä viettelevän arvoituksen kanssa paljastaakseen järkyttäviä totuuksia ja saadakseen takaisin identiteettinsä.

programme.title: Mutaa kuonoon! Sanoo virtahepo
programme.desc: "Hyväsydämiset Slim ja Tom törmäävät Afrikassa vaikutusvaltaiseen saksalaiseen Jack Ormondiin, joka viettää luksuselämää pyydystämällä villieläimiä ja lähettämällä ne eläintarhaan Kanadaan. programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Power Rangers on viiden tavallisen lukiolaisen tarina. He löytävät ikivanhan avaruusaluksen ja huomaavat yhtäkkiä saaneensa yliluonnolliset voimat. Viisikko äkkää, että muukalaiset aikovat tuhota heidän pienen kotikaupunkinsa Angel Groven ja siinä samassa koko maailman, joten heidän on ryhdyttävä maailmanpelastajiksi.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Toiminnantäyteisessä sci-fi -trillerissä ryhmä nuoria amerikkalaisia on vierailulla Moskovassa, kun muukalaislaji hyökkää kaupunkiin ja syöksee heidät keskelle epätoivoista selviytymistaistelua. Näkymättömät, puhtaasta energiasta koostuvat olennot muuttavat säälittä kohtaamansa ihmiset tuhkaksi pelkällä kosketuksellaan.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Luc Bessonin toimintaelokuvan pääosassa upea Zoe Saldana (Avatar) pukeutuu koston mustaan raivatessaan tieltään vanhempiensa tappajat.COLOMBIANA on toiminnantäyteinen tarina nuoresta tytöstä, joka joutuu raakuuksien ja koston maailmaan. CATALEYA RESTREPO (Zoe Saldana) todistaa 10-vuotiaana vanhempiensa brutaalin murhan, jonka takana on pahamaineinen kolumbialainen rikollispomo DON LUIS. Cataleya pakenee EMILIO-setänsä luo Chicagoon, jossa hänestä kasvaa tappavan kaunis kuoleman lähetti...

programme.title: Murder Company
programme.desc: Murder Company perustuu tositapahtumiin toisen maailmansodan aikana ja seuraa amerikkalaissotilaiden erikoista ryhmää D-Dayn hyökkäyksen aikana. Komppanialla on mahdoton tehtävä: Ranskan vastarintaliikkeen jäsen viedään natsien tukikohtaan, jossa hän salamurhaa tärkeän kohteen.

programme.title: Van Veeteren: Pääsky, kissa, ruusu, kuolema
programme.desc: Van Veeteren –elokuvat perustuvat Håkan Nesserin menestysromaaneihin. Tapahtumat sijoittuvat fiktiiviseen Pohjois-Euroopan kaupunkiin nimeltä Maardam, ja seuraavat eläkkeelle jääneen komisario Van Veeterenin (Sven Wollter) ja hänen suojattiensa – rikosetsivien Münster (Thomas Hanzon) ja Moreno (Eva Rexed) - edesottamuksia. Münster löytää nuoren naisen kotoaan murhattuna ja onnistuu yllättämään murhaajan, joka on vielä asunnossa. Murhaaja onnistuu kuitenkin pakenemaan, mutta jättää jälkeensä erikoisen kirjan, joka sisältää terveiset syylliseltä.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banaani Joen elämä on yhtä auringonpaistetta. Lokoisaa iloista oloa, ilman stressiä eteläisellä paratiisisaarella, kunnes... Joen asuinkylä on jäämässä modernin business-kulttuurin jalkoihin. Pian paikkaa pyörittävät byrokraatit ja jengit, pykälineen ja paheineen. Korruptio ja sääntöviidakko alkavat rehottaa paratiisissa, ja huoleton vapauden aurinko on jäämässä pahasti pyrkyreiden ja rahastajien varjoon. Joe ei lainkaan pidä siitä mitä on tapahtumassa, eikä ole valmis luopumaan idyllisestä paratiisistaan ilman taistelua. On aika takoa nyrkein joidenkin päähän järkeä, ja näyttää mistä kuuluu ja kuka käskee!

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Costa Rica Calling Chilamate
programme.desc: In the heart of Costa Rica's countryside, Genevieve embarks on a journey of cultural immersion in Chilamate.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: Robbie’s adventures in Perth kick off with him immersing himself in the historic grandeur of the Scone Castle, where a mysterious stone tells tales of Scottish monarchs. But the real thunder of the Highlands awaits at the Braemar Games gathering, where tartan meets brawn, and Robbie learns that embracing his Scottish side involves more than just kilts and castles.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Backpack Novi Sad, Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Novi Sad, the financial and industrial hub of Serbia.Starting with canoeing on Danube and later exploring the city and its landmarks.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Boarding Pass Santa Village, Finland
programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to Santa Village at Rovaniemi, where she reads some of the letters that children from around the world write to him.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Xplore Bulgaria Sunny Beach
programme.desc: Luxurious hotels, thrilling water parks, inexpensive food and almost 300 days of bright sunny weather make Bulgaria’s biggest seaside resort, Sunny Beach popular for budget beach getaways. Catriona, however, stumbles onto the historic town of Nessebar, which is over 3000 years old, and realizes that there is more to the place than meets the eye. She goes on to visit the Castra Rubra winery, where she finds out about the history of Viticulture in Bulgaria and the process of wine making.

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Benafsha embarks on a whirlwind adventure in Ahmedabad. With just 48 hours in the city, she is determined to make the most of it, but how?

programme.title: Food Fact Fun
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Food Fact Fun The Hague, Netherlands
programme.desc: From exploring a vintage car museum to scaling a 5 meter ice-wall and sampling a rich bread cookie, Watch Alex exploring The Hague, also known as the “International city of peace”.

programme.title: 10 Days Scotland
programme.desc: A modern European oil city built on the back of a rich maritime heritage, Aberdeen is the energetic kingpin of northeast Scotland. While the boom times may come and go, the dynamic coastal metropolis never ceases to thrill with its free museums, outdoor adventures and natural attractions right on the city’s doorstep.

programme.title: Backpack Serbia
programme.desc: Heather explores Požarevac and visits the ancient town of Viminacium. Later visits National Museum, concluding with Majdanpek’s Rajkova Pecina Caves.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Boarding Pass Rovaniemi, Finland
programme.desc: Emeline Nsingi Nkosi goes to Rovaniemi, where she visits a husky farm and finds out about about breeding and raising huskies.

programme.title: Xplore Bulgaria
programme.desc: For the people of Sofia, preserving its heritage is sacrosanct, and this can be seen in the way the city's infrastructure is built around its archeological treasures. Catriona realizes this when she roams around the cobblestone streets of the city. With every monument she visits, she finds herself transported to a different era, right from Perperikon fort, which narrate stories of the Byzantine empire, to Boyana church, which is home to some of the earliest examples of medieval artwork.

programme.title: Great World Hotels

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - David Jeannerot
programme.desc: David Jeannerot left the world of fashion and abandoned his career as artistic director to become a plant. An exceptional florist who wishes to give back all its place to nature in the city.David had a dream life. He traveled around the world for major ready-to-wear brands. But under the appearance David was actually very isolated. To give meaning to his life, and to go in the direction of his personal convictions, he decides to become a plantist. He arranges corners of greenery on the smallest window sill with the aim of bringing nature to the city, and to make Paris greener.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Agostina (Argentina)
programme.desc: When Agostina’s mother was diagnosed with breast cancer, she began seeking out soft natural fabrics that would not irritate her mother’s sensitive skin. She found it almost impossible to find the right materials, so she decided to make her own. Research led her to bamboo fibers and she realised she could make a positive impact on the environment, while developing sustainable and ethical fashion.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Solenn (Nantes)
programme.desc: A former school teacher reinvents herself when she discovers a passion for sharing other women’s stories. Always inspired by the journeys of strong women, Solenn began a blog to celebrate the women in her community. Solenn’s energy and passion fueled a dream of starting her own magazine. Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign, this dream blossomed into a professional career in journalism and she launched a print mook (magazine & book) called Etonnantes. Etonnantes features interviews of women of all backgrounds, celebrating their diversity and success in each field.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Sophie (Nantes)
programme.desc: Always an artist at heart, Sophie grew up in the countryside amongst nature and farm animals. Her love for creating art while respecting nature turned into a drive to seek out sustainable vegetable dyes.Today, her artwork and craft are intertwined as she makes beautiful prints and motifs that she colours with natural dyes, prepared from handpicked variety of flowers and plants that turn into stunning creations.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The Bordeaux country
programme.desc: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Poultry on the menu
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Poultry on the menu
programme.desc: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew. Julie will then head back up towards the center to discover an amazing fly maker who uses rooster feathers!

programme.desc: Without really knowing why, Paul Elliott will change his life from cartoonist to massage therapist. Aspired by success, money, success, he will create several clinics and will eventually lose the human aspects and lose himself. A new turn, a new meeting and Paul will finally resume his dreams of painting. Follow Paul in his tumults and his happiness found.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Annabelle Higgins and Valérie Sirois
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Annabelle Higgins and Valérie Sirois
programme.desc: They are beautiful sisters, they are passionate about nature and they have a very strong common point: entrepreneurship. After years of evolution in consumer sectors, discover Annabelle and Valérie who knew how to listen to their passion to create a fitness and surf club (for Annabelle) and a zero waste grocery store (for Valérie).

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Véronick Desmarais
programme.desc: The everyday work is not always easy and it is sometimes difficult to get by. If there is one thing that Véronick has learned from her experience and those around her, it is because she is able to surpass that and to embark on her dreams and plans to become a massage therapist. You will believe in your abilities too.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Violaine Courtois
programme.desc: Everything started from the dream of her parents, she becomes a veterinarian. In her career that she launched backwards, Violaine will meet people who will take her to a different path of life. The chance will be at the rendezvous but it is especially the courage to resume studies and create his company that will build his project. Follow the encounters and travels of Violaine that brought her to fasciatherapy and nonviolent communication.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Leah
programme.desc: Working 12 hours a day in the tech industry, Leah was living a fast paced high-life that only looked good on paper. Frequently ill and constantly exhausted, she experienced a burn out and decided to tackle meditation. What came next was a radical change in lifestyle that resulted in a move to Bali, The Island of the Gods. Today she sees her career blossom as she enjoys sharing her meditation knowledge with the world.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The wine route
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established. Julie will take us to Burgundy, where the most expensive wines in the world are produced, and then back to Bordeaux, to immerse ourselves in the world of high-tech and biodynamic wines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - winter vegetables
programme.desc: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits. Finally, we will conclude as usual with a recipe from a chef, who will go out of his way to create a seasonal recipe for us.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Earth does not belong to Man, Man belongs to the Earth - Part 2
programme.desc: In Florida, the Everglades swamp is being restored at great expense. 15 billion dollars are being invested over thirty years to save the water supply of the entire region. In California, on the crests of the Tehachapi hills, the world's largest wind farm is being discovered. In China, the fermentation of excrement produces gas, mainly methane, which, when burned, is transformed into energy called biogas. In California, the Taft oil field was discovered, one of the largest in the world: nearly 10,000 wells on over 52,000 hectares. Then Haiti fights to save itself from deforestation. In Utah, Salt Lake City is a good example of how we live today: there are 37 cities in the world with more...

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Andrew
programme.desc: For many years, Andrew was a successful American child-actor on the popular show My Wife and Kids, until he dropped everything and embarked on a journey to find life’s true meaning. He now lives in Bali where he coaches people from all over the world on how to radically transform their diets. His 360° transformative journey includes meditation, yoga and nutrition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The mushroom route
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Truffle flavors
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. Truffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Everything is living and everything is linked - Part 1
programme.desc: Through the most magnificent images and astonishing human stories, Man is at the heart of the biodiversity that he must respect and preserve. Then, in the sanctuary of life, the Pantanal region in Brazil, where millions of animal and plant species are teeming, some of the world's great wetlands also in danger. In Tasmania, Yann Arthus-Bertrand fights against the napalm deforestation of one of the oldest and most beautiful forests...

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The Auxerre country
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The chestnut route
programme.desc: Julie takes to the road in her little red car to honour one of her favourite fruits: the chestnut. Julie will meet several producers in Ardèche, cook the traditional soup of the region with the sparkling Marithé. She will also make the recipe for homemade marrons glacés, before heading to Corsica to work with chestnut flour and the leaves of her tree. This journey will end as always with a clever chef's recipe, and this time it will be Claude Brioude who will do it! This chef likes to shake up the rules and will work the chestnut with fish, two seasonal products that we are not usually used to combining.

programme.desc: To make a profession representative of his personality is the discovery made by Guillaume at twenty-six. programme.desc: It took a burnout and several miscarriages to Laurence to take a new path. It's finally a bad thing for a good. programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The country of Fontainebleau
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The country of Fontainebleau
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Fish on the menu
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Fish on the menu
programme.desc: Julie takes us to the southern Brittany and more precisely the maritime district of Guilvinec to follow the fish route from the nets to your plate. Le Guilvinec may be the first French artisanal fishing port, but all the seashores of France have good seasonal products. Julie drives up to the south to discover several farmed fish in an aquaculture farm in the Mediterranean, while cooking sea bass in Noirmoutier, monkfish in the north and even cod in the huge market at Rungis. Julie challenged Chef Olivier Bellin, who lives in Plomodiern in Finistère, to cook a little-known fish: the wrasse.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Yesmin
programme.desc: Born in Mexico but always attracted to new cultures and countries, Yesmin worked many jobs until she finally found her calling. programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Jessica

Today, she runs mindful surf & yoga retreats while also working online as a wellness writer.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Lisa & Pete

programme.desc: It is in Giverny that Julie's journey begins, the place whose name resounds as the cradle of Impressionism has kept a moving authenticity. His recipe books are there to testify to this. It’s with these notebooks that Julie will be inspired to fill hers, on the menu: Rabbit in compote, andouilles puff pastry with camembert, and apricot charlottes.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Game season

Julie will also meet two hunters from Gironde for a very original afternoon of hunting by the barrel before joining Joël in Aquitaine for another game bird recipe. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey attempts to pull through with several luck-based cards, but Johnson's cheating tactics ruin all his chances, until an angry Noah puts a stop to him.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Tristan, Duke and Serenity duel Nesbitt, the Big 5's mechanical expert. Serenity's lack of experience with the game and Nesbit's powerful machine monsters create a tragic end for Tristan.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: With Tristan gone and Serenity in shock, Duke attempts to defeat Nesbitt by himself. But when Orgoth the Relentless is destroyed by his Perfect Machine King, Duke tries to help Serenity regain confidence in her abilities. The two later remember Tristan's face down card, hoping it will help them win.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E11 Settling the Score — Part 1
programme.desc: As Nesbitt (in Tristan's body) kidnaps Mokuba, Kaiba is forced to duel Lector, the former assistant to his stepfather. For Lector, the duel is personal, as he plans to take what he believes is rightfully his—KaibaCorp. Meanwhile, Tristan rejoins the group; his friends do not recognize him, since his mind has been downloaded into a mechanical monkey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E12 Settling the Score — Part 2
programme.desc: With Lector's Jinzo Deck Master destroying all of Kaiba's traps, Imperial Order destroying all his spell cards, and Lector's unreachable Satellite Cannon striking from space, Kaiba doesn't seem to stand a chance. Mokuba's unwavering faith in Kaiba keeps him believing that his brother will pull out with a victory, but Noah has plans to ruin their brotherhood.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi, Kaiba, and Tea are separated from the others as the Big 5 (minus Nesbitt) plan to take their bodies anyway. As Noah tortures Kaiba by brainwashing Mokuba, he reveals his true identity as Gozaboro Kaiba's biological son.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E14 Merger of the Big Five — Part 1
programme.desc: Noah gives the Big Five one last chance to redeem themselves in a five-on-two tag team duel where Yugi and Joey take on the entire Big Five, who are using Tristan's body.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E15 Merger of the Big Five — Part 2
programme.desc: The Big 5 attempt various strategies of victory, with the aim of eliminating Joey first. However, their poor teamwork soon puts Yugi and Joey ahead. Lector then calls their most powerful monster to the field, the Five Head Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E16 Merger of the Big Five — Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey are forced to use their strongest monsters to take down the Five-Headed Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E17 Brothers in Arms — Part 1
programme.desc: Kaiba and Noah duel for full control of KaibaCorp, but Noah's revelations and constant manipulation of the playing field complicate things for Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E18 Brothers in Arms — Part 2
programme.desc: Noah's Shinato's Ark puts Kaiba in a difficult position, as he scrambles to find a winning strategy.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E19 Brothers in Arms — Part 3
programme.desc: Kaiba regains control of the duel, but Noah brings a brainwashed Mokuba out to hinder his plans. After finally breaking through to Mokuba, Kaiba tries to embrace his brother before Noah, jealous over their close relationship, turns them to stone.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E20 Noah's Final Threat — Part 1
programme.desc: Enraged at Noah's cruel games, Yugi takes over for Kaiba and duels Noah with only 400 life points.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E21 Noah's Final Threat — Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi's efforts to win the duel are further complicated by Noah, who turns all of his friends into stone statues, leaving Yugi feeling alone and without hope.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E22 So Close Yet So Far
programme.desc: Gozaboro Kaiba reveals himself and plans to virtualize the entire world to create a digital kingdom. With Noah's unlikely aid, Yugi and the others must escape while fending off memories from the past.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E23 Burying the Past — Part 1
programme.desc: Using Mokuba's body, Noah escapes and sets the virtual world to self-destruct. But Mokuba's kindness breaks through his heart, and he tries to set the others free. Meanwhile, Kaiba duels Gozaboro, who summons a seemingly unstoppable monster—Exodia Necross.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E24 Burying the Past — Part 2
programme.desc: ami Marik destroys the computers in the control room, disabling the controls for the self-destruct mechanism, which turns the situation desperate. Meanwhile, Kaiba defeats Gozoboro Kaiba, and he and Yugi rush to the exit before the virtual world explodes. Noah erases Gozoboro's files and releases his mind, and finally makes peace with his family, and prepares for the destruction of the virtual world.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E25 Back to Battle City — Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi and the others arrive at KaibaCorp Island and The Battle City Finals resume. To decide who will duel whom, the four duelists--Yugi, Joey, Kaiba, and Marik-- face each other in a four-way duel in the Duel Tower.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E26 Back to Battle City — Part 2
programme.desc: The four-way duel continues with Joey determined to duel Marik in order to save Mai while Marik and Kaiba both intend to face Yugi. Meanwhile, Ishizu reflects on her past.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E27 Back to Battle City — Part 3
programme.desc: With the conclusion of the four-way duel, the match-ups for the semi-finals are determined — Joey will duel Marik while Yugi will be facing off against Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E28 The Darkness Returns — Part 1
programme.desc: Marik brings Joey and himself to the Shadow Realm, where each duelist's heart is linked with his monsters, suffering the pain that the monsters feel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E29 The Darkness Returns — Part 2
programme.desc: Marik's duel tactics eat away at Joey's deck and his life points. Joey's comeback strategy, however is hindered by Marik's new monster on Joey's side of the field.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E30 The Darkness Returns — Part 3
programme.desc: With life points dropping and his monsters unable to attack, Joey summons a monster that proves to be his saving grace, prompting Marik to unleash Ra.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E31 The Darkness Returns — Part 4
programme.desc: Despite surviving Marik's onslaught, Joey is weakened by the shadow game's effects and succumbs just as he is about to win the duel. Yugi struggles to find hope after losing his best friend to the Shadow Realm.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E32 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 1
programme.desc: The second duel of the semi-finals begins with Yugi dueling Kaiba for the second spot in the grand final and the chance to duel Marik. Kaiba draws Obelisk on his first turn, but Yugi thwarts his attempts to summon it with Lightforce Sword.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E33 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba and Yugi compete to summon their monsters to the field, but each is hindered by the other's strategies.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E34 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 3
programme.desc: Kaiba is able to summon Obelisk the Tormentor, to the field, putting it at odds with Yugi's own Slifer the Sky Dragon.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E35 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 4
programme.desc: With the destruction of both their monsters, Kaiba and Yugi are presented with a vision of the High Priest's legendary battle against the Pharaoh. Kaiba believes this to be a mere illusion, but Yugi knows that it is a vision of the past. The duel continues with Kaiba and Yugi attacking with their signature cards.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E36 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 5
programme.desc: Kaiba gains a lead in the duel when he summons three Blue Eyes White Dragons. Yugi's hopes of winning come to an end, but receives some encouragement from Joey and stays strong in the game. Meanwhile, Joey's dreams and the ongoing duel cause Joey to awake.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E37 Clash in the Coliseum — Part 6
programme.desc: Kaiba's final move forces the duelists to use only three cards, forcing to use the best cards in the decks to win the duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E38 Battle for the Bronze — Part 1
programme.desc: Tired of Kaiba's constant ridicule, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City tournament.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E39 Battle for the Bronze — Part 2
programme.desc: Joey manages to gain one of Kaiba's strongest cards to help him advance in the duel. Meanwhile, Téa – possessed by the good half of Marik's soul – fights Yami Marik for control of the Millennium Rod.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E40 Battle for the Bronze — Part 3
programme.desc: After defeating Joey and taking third place in the tournament, Kaiba plans to destroy the Duel Tower and bury his past forever. Ishizu and Mokuba convince him otherwise, and he gives Yugi one all-powerful card that could give him a chance to defeat Marik in the final duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E41 The Final Face Off — Part 1
programme.desc: The final duel of Battle City begins. Yami Marik quickly turns it into a shadow game and sets it up so that if he or the Pharaoh loses, their host's soul will be destroyed. Yugi convinces the Pharaoh not to worry about him and to keep dueling to save Mai, Bakura and the good Marik. Yami Marik quickly discards his Winged Dragon of Ra to the graveyard, planning to revive it. Yugi manages to summon Slifer the Sky Dragon using his three Knights.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E42 The Final Face Off — Part 2
programme.desc: Marik uses Ra's effect to destroy Slifer and revives it once again to attack Yugi. Yugi plays the card Kaiba gave him, Fiend's Sanctuary, to stop Marik's attack. He then uses Multiply in order to summon Obelisk the Tormentor and devastate Marik.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E43 The Final Face Off — Part 3
programme.desc: Marik's good half possesses Tea again and begs Yugi to destroy him along with his evil side,but he eventually weakens and begins fading away as his dark half loses life points. Yugi and the Pharaoh become hesitant to duel, not wanting to harm the good Marik. As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. In a cliffhanger, Odion is revealed to have been awakened by Marik's apology.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E44 The Final Face Off — Part 4
programme.desc: Yugi continues fending off Marik's attacks, holding out until he has the cards he needs to defeat Marik. Finally, he summons Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl and uses them to activate Ragnarok – a spell card with the ability to destroy all the monsters on Marik's field, including The Winged Dragon of Ra that he fused himself with. (The card actually negates and removes all cards Marik controls, at the cost of banishing all monsters to the graveyard that Yami Yugi has.) But Yami Marik claims that if Ra is destroyed (which will leave the good Marik with only 1 life point), then the good Marik will be too weak to resist the power of the Shadow Realm, and will consequently lose his soul....

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E45 The Final Face Off — Part 5
programme.desc: Odion tries to get the good Marik to resist his evil half. As a result, Yami Marik becomes angered, and attacks Odion with the Millennium Rod, which weakens Odion even more. Odion doesn't give up, despite Ishizu's protests. As Marik continues his onslaught (which begins to injure Odion), Odion tells Marik's good side that together, they had conquered his evil half before, and that they could do it again. Then, he tells the good Marik that since Yami Marik was created by the good Marik's hatred, he has the power to destroy him. As Yami Marik raises the Rod to deliver the final blow, the good Marik disappears from the field, and begins fighting against Yami Marik, who struggles for control...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E46 One for the Road
programme.desc: Yugi and the gang escape from the island in time, but they are forced to leave Kaiba and Mokuba behind. The brothers get away just as the island explodes using the Blue-Eyes White Jet. Yugi's group heads back to Domino City, where they say their farewells and go their separate ways.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S03 : E47 Looking Back and Moving Ahead
programme.desc: Téa shows Serenity around the city, to all the sites of the important duels of the Battle City Tournament, while Joey duels Yugi to get his Red-Eyes Black Dragon back. Téa eventually meets up with Yugi, and they head off for further adventures.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E01 A New Evil, Part 1
programme.desc: The three Egyptian God Cards are stolen! A terrifying new villain emerges! And, as if things couldn’t get any worse, real monsters begin to appear around the world, terrorizing the population!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E02 A New Evil, Part 2
programme.desc: With Seal of Orichalcos, not only can Gurimo have ten monsters on the field at once, but each creature receives a power boost!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E03 Legend of the Dragons
programme.desc: Not only is our world on the brink of apocalypse, but an entire domain of monsters is also on the verge of collapse!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Confusion abound when enemies become friends... and friends become enemies! Yugi and the gang set off on a cross-country trek when they’re asked for help from a one-eyed former foe!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba returns to Duelist Kingdom for a showdown against Pegasus! Wielding his newest whacked-out Toon terrors, Pegasus is ready to repeat his previous victory against Kaiba!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Not only does Alister’s mighty fiend gain attack points for every fiery monster on the field, but it can also take control of Kaiba’s monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: On the way to Industrial Illusions, Yugi and friends are ambushed by a band of motorcycle thugs - until their favorite friend soars to the rescue!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E08 My Freaky Valentine, Part 1
programme.desc: Can this be?! Mai has joined the enemy! Wielding the sinister sorcery of Seal of Orichalcos, Mai unequivocally calculates to trap Joey’s soul for Dartz’s malevolent master plan!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E09 My Freaky Valentine, Part 2
programme.desc: Taking advantage of the arcane abilities of Seal of Orichalcos, Mai coordinates her Harpie Ladies into devastating combat formations!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E10 My Freaky Valentine, Part 3
programme.desc: With the potent powers of Claw of Hermos, Joey transforms Time Wizard into an almighty... hammer?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Professor Hawkins has discovered startling connections between the world’s chaotic conundrums, the Orichalcos stones and a lost civilization!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E12 Fate of the Pharaoh, Part 1
programme.desc: Isolated on a steep mesa in Death Valley, it’s a Wild West showdown between Yugi and his fiercest challenge yet: Rafael and his group of guardian monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 Fate of the Pharaoh, Part 2
programme.desc: Dartz’s master plan is finally revealed, and capturing Yugi’s soul is the catalyst to reset the very essence of history!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E14 Fate of the Pharaoh, Part 3
programme.desc: Using the awesome abilities of Seal of Orichalcos, Yugi grinds Rafael’s guardians into garbage... but he’s also slowly succumbing to the card’s evil influence!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Dartz has captured Yugi’s soul! Having betrayed his dearest friend, the Pharaoh sinks into the darkest depths of despair and loses his will to save the world!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E16 On the Wrong Track, Part 1
programme.desc: Divide and conquer - it’s a train ride to terror! A cross-country expedition turns tragic when Dartz’s new duelists separate Yugi from Joey in order to capture their souls separately!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E17 On the Wrong Track, Part 2
programme.desc: While Weevil sneakily infests and genetically manipulates Yugi’s monsters to metamorphose them into crude creepy crawlers, Rex Raptor’s prehistoric predators take a more forceful approach and run roughshod over Joey’s forces!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S04 : E18 On the Wrong Track, Part 3
programme.desc: Having lost the trust of Timaeus, Yugi can no longer use his guardian dragon against Weevil’s insect invasion!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The train derails and plummets into a chasm, leaving Yugi and Téa totally lost in the Rocky Mountains!

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 A King and His Queen S1 E36
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S03 : E05 Jodha Akbar S3 E5
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E41 A King and His Queen S1 E41
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.desc: (Octopussy/Britannia-USA 1983). James Bondin (Roger Moore) agenttikollegan kuolema väärennetyn Faberge-munan vuoksi kuljettaa sankariagentin Intiaan, jossa prinssi Khan (Louis Jordan) pyörittää neuvostoliittolaisten arvoesineiden salakuljetusoperaatiota kuvankauniin Octopussyn (Maud Adams) avustuksella. Elokuvan pohjana ollut Ian Flemingin novelli julkaistiin ensimmäisen kerran Playboy-lehdessä keväällä 1966. programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Kausi 16. Jakso 20/20. Valitut. Raportit ufosieppauksista ovat lisääntyneet viime vuosina räjähdysmäisesti, ja joidenkin mukaan avaruusolennot valitsevat tiettyjä ihmisiä kertomaan maailmalle pian alkavasta uudesta ihmiskunnan aikakaudesta. Amerikkalainen dokumentaarinen sarja. (40')

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 8/20. Kalliit eväät. Indonesiasta saapuneella miehellä ei omien sanojensa mukaan ole mitään tullattavaa. Konttitarkastuslaitoksessa selvitellään epäilyttävän kontin sisältöä. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 9/20. Epäonnen luku. Taiwanista saapuu 13 matkustajaa, jotka väittävät, etteivät tunne toisiaan. Rajavartijat eivät kuitenkaan usko vakuutteluita. Postikeskuksessa tutkitaan kukkalähetystä. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Suomen huutokauppakeisari
programme.desc: Kausi 9. Jakso 3/14. Tervattu kaapelikela. Emma Kimiläinen myy Helille Heljää. Pihapöytä tuunataan kaapelikelasta, päivänvarjosta ja tervasta. Aki on tehnyt Erkille eväät huutokauppaan. Kotimainen realitysarja. (41')

programme.title: Suomen huutokauppakeisari
programme.desc: Kausi 9. Jakso 4/14. Pontikkapannu myytävänä. Tarjolla olisi pontikkapannu, mutta uskaltaako Aki ostaa sen? Laulaja Suvi Karjulan pinssejä ja patcheja himoitaan. Renki-Markku tekee renginkaapin. Kotimainen realitysarja. (42')

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 17/20. Koetulos syynissä. Vietnamilaista opiskelijaa kuulustellaan asiakirjan väärentämiseen liittyen. Ranskalainen vauvanvaatepaketti osoittautuu luultua arvokkaammaksi. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 18/20. Matkanjohtajan ahdinko. Thaimaalainen matkanjohtaja odotuttaa ryhmäänsä, kun hän joutuu bioturvallisuusvirkailijan syyniin. Kiinalainen opiskelija joutuu selittelemään opintojensa jumittamista. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Savotta
programme.desc: Kausi 2. Jakso 2/6. Floridassa paikallinen eläimistö ja maasto aiheuttavat haasteita Eikalle. OP korjailee myrskyn aiheuttamia tuhoja Pielavedellä, ja Antti suunnittelee jo seuraavan talven savottaa. Roope vierailee mittauskeikalla Kemijärvellä. (42')

programme.title: Savotta
programme.desc: Kausi 2. Jakso 3/6. Metsureiden Jukka viettää läksiäisiä ennen ansaittuja eläkepäiviä. Lumi on satanut aikaisin Kittilään, jossa Juho Kangas suuntaa kohti aamuvuoroa. Roope tekee maisemointihakkuuta Haminan suunnalla, ja Antti Ruuskanen etsii yritykselle uusia toimitiloja. (42')

programme.title: Sipoon herttua
programme.desc: Kausi 2. Jakso 4/8. Kovalainen ja Rantamäki osallistuvat SuomiAreenan yrittäjäpaneeliin. Haaviston ja Räihän välinen vaalikamppailu menee henkilökohtaisuuksiin. Martikainen ei osaa tehdä päätöstä. (22')

programme.title: Sipoon herttua

programme.title: Sipoon herttua

programme.title: Kuppilat kuntoon, Gordon Ramsay!
programme.desc: Kausi 9. Jakso 10/11. Somediivan elkeitä. Gordonilla palaa hermot ravintoloitsijaan, joka ei välitä ruoan tasosta, vaan somejulkisuudesta. Hän yrittää auttaa, mutta ravintola ei voi toimia, jos sometus on tärkeämpää kuin kokkaaminen. Saako Gordon taottua järkeä sometähden päähän? Amerikkalainen realitysarja. (39')

programme.title: Panttilainaamo

Corey on klassikkoelokuvan pauloissa, ja Chum ottaa riskin toisen maailmansodan aikaisen pelastusraketin kanssa. Riskialtista on myös sen testaaminen. Amerikkalainen realitysarja. (39')

Panttitiskillä hämmästyttävät myös muinainen votiivipöllö, fossiili ja halittava isojalka. Amerikkalainen realitysarja. (39')

programme.title: Erikoisjoukot
programme.desc: Kausi 5. Jakso 10/16. Johtajuus. Vihollisjoukot ovat kokelaiden jäljillä. Pystyykö ryhmänjohtaja paikkaamaan virheensä ja kokoamaan ryhmänsä? Tukikohdan läpi yön kestävä puolustustaistelu alkaa. Kotimainen realityohjelma. (40')

programme.title: No title
programme.desc: (Never Say Never Again/Britannia-USA-Länsi-Saksa 1983). Sean Connery palaa sankariagentti James Bondin rooliin 12 vuoden tauon jälkeen vauhdikkaassa seikkailussa, joka saa alkunsa SPECTRE-agenttien ryöstäessä kaksi ydinkärjillä varustettua risteilyohjusta Yhdysvaltain ilmavoimien tukikohdasta Britanniassa. Bond lähetetään jäljittämään maailmanrauhaa uhkaavia aseita, ja monipolvinen matka kuljettaa agentin Lontoosta Bahamalle, Nizzan paratiisimaisemiin ja edelleen Pohjois-Afrikan rannikolle. Petollisen Bond-tytön Domino Petachin roolissa nähdään Kim Basinger. Ohjaaja Irvin Kershner muistetaan myös Star Wars -seikkailusta Imperiumin vastaisku. Älä kieltäydy kahdesti on uusintatulkinta Ian Flemingin romaanista Pallosalama, joka filmattiin ensimmäisen kerran jo vuonna 1965. Pääosissa: Sean Connery, Kim Basinger, Klaus Maria Brandauer, Max Von Sydow, Bernie Casey, Alec McCowen. Ohjaus: Irvin Kershner. (128')

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 11/20. Miljoonatiilet. Papua-Uudesta-Guineasta Brisbaneen saapunut lentorahti on ilmoitettu poranteriksi, mutta sen todellinen sisältö on erittäin laitonta ja lähes sadan miljoonan dollarin arvoista. Filippiineiltä Brisbaneen palaava nainen tuo mukanaan eläviä ja elottomia bioturvallisuusuhkia. Tupakkatuotteiden tullimaksujen väistely tulee kalliiksi neljälle nuorelle miehelle Melbournessa. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 12/20. Kiinalainen katoamistemppu. Sydneyn lentoasemalle saapuva nepalilaismies tekeytyy turistiksi, mutta hänen todelliset aikeensa vaikuttavat olevan jotain muuta. Samalle lentoasemalle saapuu kaksi kiinalaista naista, joista toinen järjestää erikoisen tempauksen jouduttuaan vaikeuksiin. Sydneyn kansainvälisessä postikeskuksessa tutkitaan kahta epäilyttävää pakettia. Australialainen realitysarja.
